content: Yinni Gusunɔ u Yerusɑlɛmu yen kɔ̃sɑ sɔ̃ɔsi sɑɑ Esekiɛlin nɔɔn di, u nɛɛ,
Yerusɑlɛmu, bɑ nun mɑrɑwɑ Kɑnɑnin temɔ. Wunɛn tundo u sɑ̃ɑwɑ Amɔrebɑn bweseru. Mɑ wunɛn mɛro u sɑ̃ɑ Hɛtibɑn bweseru.
Dɔmɑ te bɑ nun mɑrɑ bɑ ǹ nun bwiɑ bure. Bɑ ǹ mɑɑ nun woburɑ ɑ kɑ dɛɛrɑ. Bɑ ǹ nun sĩre kɑ bɔru. Bɑ ǹ mɑɑ nun bekuru tɛ̃kusi.
Goo kun wunɛn wɔnwɔndu kue u sere nun ɡɑ̃ɑ nin ɡɑɑ kuɑ. Adɑmɑ bɑ nun kɔ̃wɑ yɑkɑsɔ dɔmɑ te bɑ nun mɑrɑ, domi bɑ nun tusɑ.
Sɑɑ ye nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ sɑrɔ wunɛn bɔkuɔ, nɑ wɑ ɑ wɔri mɔ̀ wunɛn mɑru yɑ̃nu sɔɔ. Mɑ nɑ ɡeruɑ nɑ nɛɛ, bu de ɑ n wɑ̃ɑ bɑɑ mɛ ɑ yɛm woburɑ.
Mɑ nɑ derɑ ɑ kpɛ̃ɑ nɡe dɑ̃ɑ yɑkɑsɔ. A kpɛ̃ɑ ɑ kuɑ kurɔ burɔ. Wunɛn bwɑ̃su su ye. Mɑ wunɛn seri yi kpɛ̃ɑ. Adɑmɑ tererɑ ɑ sĩimɔ mɑm mɑm.

Mɑ nɑ sɑrɑ wunɛn bɔkuɔ nɑ nun mɛɛrɑ mɑ nɑ wɑ sɑɑ yɑ turɑ su kɑ kĩru ko. Mɑ nɑ nɛn yɑberun soo suɑ nɑ kɑ wunɛn tereru wukiri. Mɑ nɑ kɑ nun ɑrukɑwɑni bɔkuɑ kɑ bɔ̃ri nɑ nɛɛ, ɑ kuɑ nɛɡii. Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni ɡeruɑ.
Mɑ nɑ nun woburɑ kɑ nim, nɑ yɛm mɛ ɑ mwɑɑre wunɑ, mɑ nɑ nun ɡum sɑwɑ.
Mɑ nɑ nun yɑbe te bɑ sɔmɑ kuɑ dokeɑ kɑ bɑrɑ ni bɑ kuɑ kɑ ɡɔnɑ bɑ burɑru koosi, kɑ sɛ̃kɑtiɑ ye bɑ kuɑ kɑ wɛ̃ɛ dɑmɡii, kɑ sere yɑbe ɡeeru.
Mɑ nɑ nun burɑ yɑ̃nu dokeɑ kɑ sumi nɔmɑɔ kɑ sɑbɑ wĩirɔ.
Mɑ nɑ tɑɑbu doke wunɛn wɛ̃rɔ kɑ swɑɑ tonkunu kɑ sere yɑsi bɛɛrɛɡiɑ wunɛn wirɔ.

Nɡe mɛyɑ nɑ nun burɑru kuɑ kɑ wurɑ kɑ sii ɡeesu kɑ sere beku ɡeeru te bɑ kuɑ kɑ wɛ̃ɛ dɑmɡii kɑ yɑbe te bɑ sɔmɑ dokeɑ. Dĩɑ ni ɑ rɑ mɑɑ di, nu sɑ̃ɑwɑ som ɡem kɑ tim kɑ olifin ɡum. Mɑ ɑ burɑm sosimɔ ɑ dɔɔ nɡe sinɑ kurɔ.
Mɑ ɑ yĩsiru yɑrɑ bwesenun suunu sɔɔ wunɛn burɑm sɔ̃. Wunɛn burɑm mɛ, mu yibɑwɑ nɛn burɑ yɑ̃ɑ ni nɑ nun kuɑn sɔ̃. Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni ɡeruɑ.
Yerusɑlɛmu
yɑ tii kurɔ tɑnɑru kpɛ̃ɛ
Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑɑ nɛɛ, Yerusɑlɛmu, ɑ wunɛn nɑɑnɛ doke wunɛn burɑm sɔɔ. Mɑ ɑ tii kuɑ nɡe kurɔ tɑnɔ yĩsi te ɑ yɑrɑn sɔ̃. Tɔnu bɑɑwure wi u sɑrɔ mi kpuro, ɑ rɑ nùn tii wɛ̃wɑ.
Mɑ ɑ wunɛn yɑ̃ɑ nɔniɡinu suɑ ɑ kɑ dɑ ɑ wunɛn ɡunɡunu mi ɑ rɑ bũnu sɑ̃ burɑru kuɑ. Miyɑ ɑ tii wɛ̃. Ye ɑ kuɑ mi, ɡoo kun yen bweseru wɑɑre. Mɛyɑ yen bweserɑ kun mɑɑ koorɑmɔ.
Mɑ ɑ wunɛn burɑ yɑ̃ɑ ni bɑ kuɑ kɑ wurɑ kɑ sii ɡeesu suɑ ɑ kɑ bũu tɔn durɔbu sekɑ mɑ ɑ nu sɑkɑrɑru koosi.
Mɑ ɑ wunɛn yɑ̃ɑ ni bɑ sɔmɑ doke suɑ ɑ bũu ni wukiri. Mɑ ɑ mɑɑ nɛn ɡum kɑ nɛn turɑre suɑ ɑ nu wɛ̃.
Mɑ ɑ mɑɑ dĩɑ ni nɑ rɑ kɑ nun diisie suɑ ɑ kɑ bũu ni yɑ̃kuru kuɑ nɡe mɛ bɑ rɑ mɑn yɑ̃ku nubu duroruɡiru kue. Dĩɑ niyɑ som kɑ ɡum kɑ tim. Yeniwɑ yɑ koorɑ. Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni ɡeruɑ.
Adɑmɑ sɑkɑrɑ te, tɑ ǹ nun turɑ. Mɑ ɑ wunɛn bii be ɑ mɑn mɑruɑ mwɛɛrɑ ɑ kɑ bũu ni yɑ̃kuru kuɑ.
Wee ɑ nɛn bibu sɑkirɑ ɑ kɑ bũnu yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruɡiru kuɑ.
Yen kom kɔ̃sum mɛ sɔɔ, ɑ ǹ mɑɑ wunɛn wɔndiɑru yɑɑye kɑ sɑnɑm mɛ ɑ wɑ̃ɑ tereru wunɛn mɑru yɛm sɔɔ.
Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ ɡerumɔ mɑ ɑ kuɑ bɔ̃rurɑ kɔ̃sɑ ye ɑ kuɑn sɔ̃.
Wee ɑ tii sɑkɑrɑ kunu ɡirɑ kɑ mɑɑ bũu turɑnu bɑɑmɑ kpuro.
Wee swɑɑ kɛɛnɑnu bɑɑmɑ ɑ bũu turɑnu kuɑ, mɑ ɑ kom kɔ̃sum kuɑ ɑ tii tɔmbu kpuro wɛ̃. Be bɑ ɡesi sɑrɔ mi kpuro, bɑ rɑ kɑ nun dendiwɑ. Mɑ ɑ wunɛn sɑkɑrɑru kpɛ̃ɑsiɑ.
A kɑ wunɛn berusebu Eɡibitiɡibu be bɑ wɑsin dɑm mɔ mi, sɑkɑrɑru kuɑ. Mɑ ɑ wunɛn sɑkɑrɑru kpɛ̃ɑsiɑ ɑ kɑ nɛn mɔru seeyɑ.
Yerɑ nɑ nun nɛn dɑm sɔ̃ɔsi nɑ nun nɔmɑ dɛmiɛ. Mɑ nɑ nun doke nɛn yibɛrɛbɑn nɔmu sɔɔ. Yibɛrɛ berɑ, Filisitibɑ be bɑ biti soorɑ wunɛn dɑɑ kɔ̃sɑn sɔ̃.
Yen biru mɑ ɑ dɑ ɑ kɑ Asiriɡibu sɑkɑrɑru kuɑ, domi ɑ ǹ debɑ. A dɑ ɑ tii bu wɛ̃. Adɑmɑ kɑ mɛ, ɑ ǹ debɑ.
Mɑ ɑ dɑ ɑ kɑ Kɑnɑnibɑ sɑkɑrɑru kuɑ kɑ Bɑbiloniɡibu. Kɑ mɛ, ɑ ǹ debɑ.
Annɑ ɑ dɑm sɑriru wɑ mi. A tii kuɑwɑ nɡe sɑkɑrɑ kowobun yinni.
Domi ɑ sɑkɑrɑ kunu ɡirɑ swɑɑ kɛɛnɑnɔ mɑ ɑ bũu turɑnu kuɑ bɑɑmɑ kpuro, ɑ ku rɑ mɑm mɑɑ kurɔ tɑnɔ ɡobi mwɛ.
A sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe kurɔ tɑnɔ sɑkɑrɑ kowo wi u durɔ tukobu mwɑɑmɔ win durɔn ɑyerɔ.
Kurɔ tɑnɔ bɑɑwurewɑ bɑ rɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu kɛ̃. Adɑmɑ wunɛ, ɑ durɔ tɑnɔbu ɡɑ̃ɑnu wɛ̃ɛmɔ kpɑ ɑ kɑ bu ɡɑwɑmɑ beri berikɑ kpuron di.
Ye kurɔ tɑnɔbu bɑ ku rɑ ko yerɑ ɑ kuɑ sɑkɑrɑru sɔɔ, domi ye kɑɑ kɑ durɔ tɑnɔbu kɛ̃nu mwɑɑri, wunɛn tiiwɑ ɑ rɑ bu wɛ̃.
Tɛ̃, nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ nɛɛ, Yerusɑlɛmu, ɑ mɑn swɑɑ dɑkio wunɛ wi ɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɡe kurɔ tɑnɔ.
Wee ɑ derɑ bɑ wunɛn dukiɑ yɑrinɑsiɑ bɑɑmɑ, mɑ bɑ wunɛn tereru wɑ sɑnɑm mɛ ɑ sɑkɑrɑru mɔ̀ kɑ bũnu ni ɑ kĩ, ni nu kun mɑm wɑɑbu wɑ̃. Mɑ ɑ wunɛn bibun yɛm yɑri ɑ kɑ bũu ni yɑ̃kuru kuɑ.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ kon wunɛn kĩnɑsi be mɛnnɑ kɑ sere mɑɑ be ɑ tusɑ. Be kpurowɑ kon mɛnnɑmɑ bɑɑmɑ kpuron di, kpɑ n nun yɔ̃su tereru ben wuswɑɑɔ.
Kon nun sɛɛyɑsiɑwɑ nɡe mɛ bɑ rɑ tɔn ɡowobu kɑ kurɔ tɑnɔbu sɛɛyɑsie. Yɛm mu koo nun wukiri nɛn mɔru kɑ nɛn nisinun sɑɑbu.
Kon nun bɛri wunɛn kĩnɑsi ben nɔmɑɔ. Bɑ koo wunɛn kunu kɑ wunɛn ɡunɡuu ni kɔsuku. Bɑ koo wunɛn burɑ yɑ̃ɑ ni ɑ doke potiri kpɑ bu nun yɔ̃su tereru.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, kon tɔmbu seeyɑ bu nun seesi bu kpenu kɑsuku kpɑ bu nun tɑkobibɑ sɔkiri.
Bɑ koo wunɛn diɑ dɔ̃ɔ mɛniki kpɑ bu nun sɛɛyɑsiɑ kurɔ dɑbinun wuswɑɑɔ kpɑ n de wunɛn sɑkɑrɑru tu kpe. A ǹ mɑɑ ben ɡoo ɡɑ̃ɑnu wɛ̃ɛmɔ.
Nɛn mɔru koo sure. Nɑ ǹ mɑɑ kɑ nun nisinu mɔ̀. Mɛyɑ nɑ ǹ mɑɑ kɑ nun mɔru mɔ̀.
Kɑ mɛ, yèn sɔ̃ ɑ ǹ yɑɑye nɡe mɛ nɑ nun nɔɔri wunɛn birun di, mɑ ɑ nɛn mɔru seeyɑ kɑ wunɛn kookoosu, yen sɔ̃, kon de ɑ yen ɑre wɑ. Domi ɑ sekuru sɑri kom kuɑ mɑ ɑ bũnu sɑ̃wɑ.
Yerusɑlɛmuwɑ yɑ dɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ bo
Wee be bɑ rɑ mɔn teni ko bu nɛɛ, nɡe mɛ mɛro u sɑ̃ɑ, nɡe mɛyɑ win bii wɔndiɑ u rɑ n sɑ̃ɑ, bɑ koo nɛɛ, wunɑ tɑ kɑ yɑ̃.
A sɑ̃ɑwɑ wunɛn mɛron bii wi u durɔ kɑ bibu yinɑ. A sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe wunɛn mɑɑbu be bɑ durɔ kɑ bibu yinɑ. Bɛɛn mɛro u sɑ̃ɑwɑ Hɛti. Mɑ bɛɛn tundo u sɑ̃ɑ Amɔreɡii.
Wunɛn mɔɔ wi u wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑ, wiyɑ Sɑmɑri kɑ yen bii wɔndiɑbɑ. Wunɛn wɔnɔ wi u mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑru ɡiɑ wiyɑ Sodomu kɑ yen bibu.
N ǹ mɔ ben yirɑ ɑ swĩi tɔnɑ. Ye ɑ kuɑ yɑ kpɑ̃. Wee ɑ sɑnkirɑ ɑ bu kere wunɛn swɛɛ kpuro sɔɔ.
Sere kɑ nɛn wɑ̃ɑru Sodomu ye yɑ sɑ̃ɑ wunɛn wɔnɔ yɑ ǹ kue nɡe mɛ ɑ kuɑ wunɛ kɑ wunɛn bibu.
Torɑ ni yɑ kuɑ wee. Yɑ tii sue mɑ yɑ wɑ̃ɑ doo nɔɔru kɑ bɔri yɛndu sɔɔ. Yɑ ku rɑ wɔnwɔndobu kɑ sɑ̃ɑrobu somi.
Wunɛn mɛro bisi be, bɑ tɔnu bie bɑ kɔ̃sɑ kuɑ nɛn nɔni sɔɔ. Ye nɑ wɑ mɛ, yerɑ nɑ bu ɡirɑ.
Wunɛn mɔɔ Sɑmɑri kun mɑm wunɛn torɑrun sɑkɑ kue. Wunɛn kɔ̃sɑ yɑ wiɡiɑ dɑbinu kerɑ. Mɑ wunɛn kom kɔ̃sum mu derɑ bɑ nun sɑnɔ kerɑ.

Wunɛ wi ɑ rɑ rɑɑ bu tɑɑrɛ wɛ̃ wee ɑ sekuru wɑ. Domi wunɛn kom kɔ̃sum mu beɡim kerɑ. Bɑ̀ n wunɛn dɑɑ ye mɛɛrɑ bɑ rɑ deemɛwɑ be, bɑ mɑm dɛɛre. Tɛ̃ ɑ kuɑ sekuruɡii yèn sɔ̃ bɑ̀ n wunɛn dɑɑ mɛɛrɑ bɑ rɑ wɑ bɑ sɑnɔ sɑ̃ɑ.
Sodomu kɑ Sɑmɑri
yɑ koo wurɑmɑ nɡe yellu
Yinni Gusunɔ u Yerusɑlɛmu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, kon Sodomu kɑ Sɑmɑri kɑ ben bii wɔndiɑbɑ seeyɑ kɑ sere mɑɑ wunɛ Yerusɑlɛmuɡibu.
Wunɛn mɔɔ Sɑmɑri ye, kɑ wunɛn wɔnɔ Sodomu ben nukurɑ koo yɛmiɑ yèn sɔ̃ wunɛn tii ɑ sekuru wɑ.
Bɑ koo wurɑmɑ nɡe yellu be, kɑ ben bibu. Mɛyɑ mɑɑ wunɛn tii kɑɑ wurɑmɑ nɡe yellu wunɛ kɑ wunɛn bibu sɑnnu.
Sɑnɑm mɛ ɑ tii sue, ɑ rɑ kɑ Sodomu ɡɑri kowɑ kɑ tii suɑbu wunɛn kɔ̃sɑ yu sere sɔ̃ɔsirɑ bɑtumɑ sɔɔ.
Tɛ̃, wunɑ Edɔmubɑ kɑ Filisitibɑ bɑ koo yɛ̃ɛ. Wee bɑ nun ɡɛmɑ yɑm kpuro.
Mɑ ɑ wunɛn sekuru sɑriru kɑ dɑɑ kɔ̃sɑn ɑre sɔɔwɑ. Nɛ Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni ɡeruɑ.
Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ nɛɛ, wee ɑ mɑn ɡɛmɑ. A ǹ nɛn ɑrukɑwɑni yibie. Yen sɔ̃, kon nun kɔsie ye ɑ mɑn kuɑ.
Adɑmɑ kɑ mɛ, nɑ ǹ nɛn ɑrukɑwɑni ye duɑrimɔ ye nɑ kɑ nun bɔkuɑ wunɛn wɔndiɑrun di. Kon mɑɑ kɑ nun ɑrukɑwɑni bɔke yɑ n wɑ̃ɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Kɑɑ bwisiku ye ɑ kuɑ kpɑ sekuru tu nun mwɑ nɑ̀ n nun wunɛn mɑɑbu kɑ wɔnɔbu nɔmu bɛriɑ bu nun wiru kpĩiyɑ nɡe wunɛn bibu. Adɑmɑ nɑ ǹ ye mɔ̀ ɑrukɑwɑni ye nɑ kɑ nun bɔkuɑn sɔ̃.
Kon kpɑm kɑ nun nɛn ɑrukɑwɑni bɔke kpɑ ɑ ɡiɑ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔ.
Kpɑ ɑ yɑɑyɑ ye ɑ kuɑ ɡɑsɔ, kpɑ sekuru tu nun mwɑ sere ɑ kpɑnɑ ɑ ɡɑri ɡere. Adɑmɑ nɛ kon nun wunɛn torɑnu kpuro suuru kuɑ. Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni ɡeruɑ.
Gunɔ bɑkeru kɑ resɛm
